0022600222.text: The Los Angeles Lakers (10-2, 1st in the Pacific and 1st in the West) take a six-game winning streak and an 8-2 record over their last ten games into this 13th game of the season, with a 5-1 road mark. The Milwaukee Bucks (1-9, 15th in the East) have lost six straight and sit 6 games back in the Central. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, after splitting their 2025-26 series 1-1, and their last meeting was a 105-101 Lakers loss in Los Angeles on January 9, 2026. Lakers guard Quentin Grimes is day-to-day with a finger injury and is a game-time decision, having averaged 8.0 points in 26.1 minutes per game this season.
